sources.title: The Homeric Question — The Cambridge Guide to Homer
sources.citation_text: Cambridge surveys the continuing authorship problem surrounding Homer, the Iliad and the Odyssey, including oral-poetic and multi-stage composition models.

sources.title: Translating Homer: Some Issues — English Translators of Homer
sources.citation_text: This scholarly overview notes that a historical individual named Homer cannot be demonstrated incontrovertibly and emphasizes the oral-traditional basis of the poems.
